knowledge_is_bound_but_invisible: As in KC-S1a/b, and for the same reason: the phase declares knowledge 'none', bootstrap ids stay empty, and the snapshot exists only so the leakage rule has something to enforce. Measured against THIS snapshot's 11,863 protected payloads, over the directive plus all 61 blocks this fill can render: ZERO collisions, on the arm and on the twin.
predecessor_is_unprojected_and_that_is_d: predecessor_binding sealed-manifest with NO fill_params.projection, exactly as KC-S1b flew and exactly as KU-S3 declares. The comparator is KC-S1b's SEALED rows, which chose their per-intent blocks from UNPROJECTED bytes; an arm that projected would beat that comparator partly by better block selection rather than by the view.
the_channel_is_kc_s1bs_own: Every KV block travels where KC-S1b's admitted schema block travels -- the per-sample state-fill SUFFIX appended after the sealed state -- because each view REPLACES that block's five example fillers rather than sitting beside them (MF-10 section 2.3). The factor a KV cell moves is therefore the block's CONTENT at a fixed channel, contact count, roster, system message, packet, build, decoding and serving geometry.
the_one_factor: fill_params.twin. Byte-identical to the KV-3 fragment apart from the twin flag, the two speech-feature identity ids and these notes.
what_the_state_fill_renders: slurp-slot-knowledge-view-for-state resolves through rails.phase_material.PHASE_STATE_FILLS to the KV renderer family in rails.slurp_knowledge_views. For a row whose sealed closed-list response parses to an intent TRAIN carries it renders THAT intent's block alone; for a row whose response does not parse or names a (scenario, action) pair TRAIN never carries it falls back to the FULL 60-intent block, so the row still gets a legal slot instruction, and the flight counts and reports those rows. TRAIN only: load_slurp_intent_slot_schema and load_slurp_train_material have no split parameter that could reach a devel or test file. Cost, twin match and containment: docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-08-slurp-kv-views-prep/.
what_this_is: The FORM TWIN of KV-3: the same k worked examples in the same shape, drawn from a DIFFERENT intent of the SAME scenario, so they carry scenario-typical language with the wrong slot structure. Matched by MEASUREMENT rather than by construction -- mean absolute character delta 95.1 -- and the volume covariate is reported beside every number.
why_np4: The fallback block is the whole 60-intent schema on top of a 7,583-character system message and does not fit an 8,192-token slot. serving_slots 4 / serving_slot_tokens 16384 fits it with room to spare, and KC-S1b flew the same geometry so the contrast against it is geometry-matched.
